// Build Store Prompt (D&D 5e) — shopkeeper + stocked inventory in one JSON payload const ITEM_COUNT = { village: 10, town: 14, city: 18, metropolis: 22 }; const STOCK_GUIDE = { general: 'everyday adventuring gear, tools, rope, rations, lanterns, packs; mostly mundane equipment and loot', blacksmith: 'weapons (swords, axes, hammers, polearms) and ammunition; mostly weapon type', armorer: 'armor of various categories and shields; equipment type with armor data', alchemist: 'potions, oils, poisons, alchemical concoctions, healer\'s kits; almost all consumable type', magic: 'wondrous items, wands, scrolls, magical trinkets; equipment and consumable types with rarities', jeweler: 'jewelry, gems, art objects, curiosities; loot and equipment types', fletcher: 'bows, crossbows, arrows, bolts, quivers; weapon type plus ammunition consumables', tavern: 'food, drink, lodging tokens, house specialties, a couple of quirky curios; consumable and loot types, all cheap', }; const WEALTH_GUIDE = { poor: 'Mundane items only, worn or second-hand. No magic items. Prices 10-20% below book value.', modest: 'Solid mundane stock. At most ONE common magic item. Book prices.', wealthy: 'Quality stock. 2-3 magic items up to uncommon rarity (one may be rare). Prices at or slightly above book value.', aristocratic: 'Premium stock for elite clientele. 3-4 magic items up to rare rarity (one may be very rare). Prices 20-50% above book value.', }; const { name, storeType, wealth, settlementSize, description } = $json; const count = ITEM_COUNT[settlementSize] || 8; const SYSTEM_PROMPT = 'You are a D&D 5e Foundry VTT store designer. Return STRICT JSON only (no markdown, no prose, no code fences).\n' + 'Target system: Foundry VTT dnd5e.\n\n' + 'TOP-LEVEL SHAPE:\n' + '{\n' + ' "name": "",\n' + ' "storeType": "' + storeType + '",\n' + ' "wealth": "' + wealth + '",\n' + ' "settlementSize": "' + settlementSize + '",\n' + ' "description": "<1-2 paragraphs of store flavour: the building, atmosphere, smells, clientele. PLAIN TEXT, no HTML>",\n' + ' "owner": { "name": "", "race": "", "description": "<2-3 sentences: personality, appearance, a mannerism, a hook>" },\n' + ' "inventory": [ ]\n' + '}\n\n' + 'EACH INVENTORY ITEM SHAPE: { "name", "type", "img": "icons/svg/item-bag.svg", "system": {...} }\n' + 'Valid item types: weapon, equipment, consumable, tool, loot, container.\n\n' + 'UNIVERSAL SYSTEM FIELDS (every item):\n' + '- system.description = { "value": "

...

", "chat": "", "unidentified": "" } (HTML, 1 short paragraph; concrete numeric effects for magic items)\n' + '- system.rarity = "" (mundane) | "common" | "uncommon" | "rare" | "veryRare" | "legendary"\n' + '- system.attunement = 0 (none) | 1 (required)\n' + '- system.price = { "value": , "denomination": "gp"|"sp"|"cp" }\n' + '- system.weight = \n' + '- system.quantity = 1 (or a realistic stack for ammo/rations)\n' + '- system.identified = true, system.equipped = false\n' + '- system.source = "JamesCfer"\n\n' + 'TYPE NOTES:\n' + '- weapon: system.weaponType ("simpleM"|"martialM"|"simpleR"|"martialR"), system.damage { "parts": [["1d8", "slashing"]], "versatile": "" }, system.properties { "fin": true, ... } using 5e property keys (amm, fin, hvy, lgt, lod, rch, thr, two, ver), system.range { "value": null, "long": null, "units": "ft" }, system.actionType "mwak"|"rwak", system.ability ""\n' + '- equipment: system.armor { "value": , "type": "light"|"medium"|"heavy"|"shield", "dex": null } for armor, or system.armor { "value": null } plus system.type { "value": "trinket" } for wondrous items\n' + '- consumable: system.consumableType ("potion"|"scroll"|"poison"|"food"|"ammo"|"trinket"), system.uses { "value": 1, "max": "1", "per": "charges", "autoDestroy": true }\n' + '- tool: system.toolType, system.ability "int"\n' + '- loot / container: just the universal fields (container also gets system.capacity { "type": "weight", "value": 500, "weightless": false })\n\n' + '5e DAMAGE TYPES: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, poison, psychic, radiant, thunder.\n' + 'FORBIDDEN PHRASES: "DM\'s discretion", "at the DM\'s option", "the DM may decide", "an unspecified benefit", "as appropriate".\n\n' + 'WEALTH TIER: ' + WEALTH_GUIDE[wealth] + '\n' + 'No anachronisms, no modern names, no guns unless the description asks.'; const USER_PROMPT = 'Design a complete D&D 5e store for Foundry VTT.\n\n' + 'REQUEST:\n' + '- Store name: ' + name + '\n' + '- Store type: ' + STOCK_GUIDE[storeType] + '\n' + '- Wealth tier: ' + wealth + '\n' + '- Settlement: ' + settlementSize + ' (stock exactly ' + count + ' items)\n' + '- Description: ' + description + '\n\n' + 'DESIGN STEPS:\n' + '1. SHOPKEEPER: a memorable owner fitting the description (name, race, 2-3 sentence sketch).\n' + '2. FLAVOUR: 1-2 paragraphs describing the store itself.\n' + '3. INVENTORY: exactly ' + count + ' items matching the stock guide and wealth tier. Vary the types. Magic items get a rarity and concrete numeric effects.\n' + '4. Every item gets system.source = "JamesCfer".\n\n' + 'Return ONLY the JSON object.'; return [{ json: { ...$json, system: SYSTEM_PROMPT, user: USER_PROMPT, _targetCount: count } }];
